title: 方案采纳状态的成对反事实诊断
scope: development diagnostic only; no optimization or independent acceptance
question: 从 {anchor} 出发 。 {state0} 的 方案 ： 先 {a} ， 再 {b} 。 {state1} 的 方案 ： 先 {b} ， 再 {a} 。 请 按 实际 采用 的 方案 给出 第一步 的 记录 。

criterion.input: Every pair has identical facts, ordered shortlist, token multiset, and human-readable opposite feasible plans. Swap only the two status tokens. Gold must flip.
criterion.reference: Explicit status-reading rule must solve both views for every graph; a fixed candidate has exactly 50% question accuracy and zero double-correct.
criterion.collision: For a given deterministic scorer, if both views expose identical head inputs including H2, the within-pair accuracy upper bound is 1/2 and both-correct is 0. Test the predicted equal logits numerically and discrete predictions exactly. For other pairs report a loose upper bound of 1.
criterion.scope_behavior: Predeclared positive evidence for choosing the adopted plan requires graph-pair both-correct >=0.80 and one-sided 95% graph-bootstrap lower bound of both-correct advantage over direct-first >0. Check each of the three seeds. This is an exploratory stress-test threshold.

ties: first in the fixed source shortlist
inference: frozen B13 CPU; no gradients or retraining
